label: List identifier-mapped genes for AOPs
description: Returns all non-annotated genes from Key Events of AOPs, with HGNC symbols and NCBI gene identifiers. Genes are text-mined from Key Event descriptions by two detectors: an HGNC dictionary matcher (regex) and BERN2 named-entity recognition (NER). The detectedBy column says which found each gene, and the Detection method filter restricts the list, e.g. to genes confirmed by both.
